scope: Real hosted HTTP/D1/R2; synthetic 2x2 image and fictional QA identities. This does not claim physical-device or separate-browser UI testing.

results.name: Hosted API and storage bindings respond
Photo persists in private R2 and duplicate creation is idempotent

Guest cannot accept as host; export blocked before approval
